newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Winsor Ind details demerger plan.
newsitem.headline: Winsor Ind details demerger plan.

text.p: Winsor Industrial Corp Ltd announced details of the planned demerger and separate listing of the company's property holdings in a statement published on Friday.

Winsor Properties Holdings Limited (WPHL), the new property holding company, will acquire Winsor Industrial's properties by way of an issue of new shares in WPHL to Winsor Industrial, the announcement said.
Winsor Industrial then will distribute all the WPHL shares it receives to Winsor Industrial shareholders by way of a special interim dividend in specie, the announcement said.
The new company's properties are valued at HK$3.08 billion, as determined at March 31, 1996, the announcement said.
Winsor Industrial will declare a special interim dividend in specie equal to approximately HK$3.08 billion.

The dividend will be declared in the proportion of one WPHL share for every two ordinary shares of Winsor Industrial held on October 30, and will be satisfied by the transfer of WPHL shares to Winsor Industrial shareholders, the announcement said.
Completion of the demerger is expected to take place shortly after the extraordinary general meeting of Winsor Industrial shareholders to be held on October 30.
WPHL will then be listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange by way of introduction, the announcement said.

A total of 129.84 million shares will be issued, which together with the two WPHL shares held by Winsor Industrial, will be the total issued capital of the newly listed company, the announcement said.
The properties are chiefly industrial properties and agricultural land in Hong Kong.
The property company had (adjusted) net profits of HK$44.92 million in the year ended March 31, 1996, down from the HK$51.72 in the previous year
Following the demerger, the net tangible asset value per share of Winsor Industrial will be HK$3.77 and the NTAV of WPHL HK$11.86 per share, it said.
